title: Turbo Turtle Adventure
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 8587 (addresses converted to GBA bus addresses)

widgets.text: Top-down puzzle adventure: guide the turtle through maze-like levels to the exit before time runs out
Coloured keys (green, red, blue) open doors of the same colour; holes make you fall and restart

rows: collect the key of a door's colour first; the HUD shows how many of each you carry
some doors need keys found deeper in the level, so explore before committing
the danger is the timer and the holes; falls are counted per save

widgets.text:
Levels in order; the level number and timer are on the Status page
Maze-like levels seen from above; the exit opens the next level
Gold helmet power-ups protect the turtle for a while

Keys of three colours and gold helmets
Gold helmets and keys are the pickups in each level
